items.subject: Petition for determination of tariff of Khurja super thermal power plant (2x660 MW) including dedicated transmission line for the period from 26.1.2025 (COD of Unit-I) to 31.3.2029, subsequent to COD of Unit II (26.9.2025) THDC India Limited

2. The Petitioner has set up the Project at Khurja in Bulandshahar District of the State of Uttar Pradesh, with a total capacity of 1320 MW, comprising two units of 660 MW each. Furthermore, the Petitioner implemented a 400-kV transmission line connecting the Project Switchyard to the PGCIL Aligarh Sub-station for power evacuation from the Project, as per the 40<sup>th</sup> meeting of the Standing Committee on Power System Planning held on 22.6.2018. The Petitioner has signed the PPAs with the Respondent, UPPCL, on 31.12.2010 and with the Respondent, UPCL and the Rajasthan Discoms, on 4.1.2011. Further, the Ministry of Power (MOP), GOI, vide its letter dated 15.11.2022, had allocated the power generated from the Project amongst the States of Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Uttarakhand as detailed below:

The Commission, vide its order dated 31.8.2025 in Petition No. 475/GT/2025, had granted an interim tariff for Unit-I of the generating station from COD (26.1.2025) till 31.3.2027 along with the Dedicated Transmission Line from the Project to Aligarh Substation from its COD till 31.3.2027. In the said order, the Commission had granted liberty to file a separate Petition in respect of Unit-II of the generating station for the determination of the tariff for the period from its actual COD till 31.3.2029, in terms of the provisions of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. 7. The Petitioner has also prayed for the grant of an interim tariff for billing purposes, subject to the determination of the final tariff.

8. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner made oral submissions and specifically prayed that, pending determination of the final tariff, an interim tariff be granted in terms of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. No Respondent appeared in the hearing, and the Commission, after hearing the Petitioner, directed for completion of the pleadings in the matter, _qua_ determination of interim tariff.

9. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner requested for the grant of interim tariff, and further submitted that none of the Respondents had  filed their

replies in the matter. None appeared on behalf of the Respondents. The Commission, after hearing the Petitioner, permitted the Respondents to file their respective replies and reserved its orders for the grant of an interim tariff for the period from 26.1.2025 (COD of Unit-I) to 31.3.2029, subsequent to COD of Unit II (26.9.2025), in terms of the 2024 Tariff Regulations.

10. 39. Further, since Unit-II of the generating station achieved COD on 26.9.2025, and the Petitioner has filed the present Petition seeking tariff for the generating station as a whole, along with the dedicated transmission line, the provisional tariff determined hereinabove subsumes the interim tariff earlier allowed vide order dated 31.8.2025 in Petition No. 475/GT/2025 (for Unit-I of the generating station along with dedicated transmission line). However, the difference between the interim annual fixed charges allowed vide said order dated 31.8.2025 and those allowed in this order shall not be recovered from the Respondents at this stage. The same shall be duly considered and adjusted at the time of final tariff determination in the present Petition, which shall be listed for hearing in due course, and a separate notice in this regard shall be issued to

the parties. In the meantime, the parties are directed to complete their pleadings.
